scope: Canonical Weyl–Moyal product, one phase-space pair, characteristic zero, hbar-independent polynomial partners of monomial Hamiltonians. No priority claim.
definition: E(H)={G in k[q,p]: [H,G]_star/(i hbar)={H,G}}; exactness is coefficientwise in hbar.

theorems.title: Canonical exponent basis
theorems.statement: For H=q^a p^b, E(H) is spanned by precisely those q^c p^d for which S_k(a,b;c,d)=0 for every odd k>=3. There is no cancellation between different partner monomials at a fixed correction order.
theorems.proof: Each order maps exponent pair (c,d) injectively to (a+c-k,b+d-k); different orders have different hbar powers.

theorems.title: Complete effective classification for every unequal a,b>=2
theorems.statement: Every partner exponent lies in finite-width strips or one rational affine line forced by the highest odd correction. All residual candidates are integer roots of finitely many nonzero degree-at-most-three polynomials, except the symbolic coordinate-axis algebra when a=2 or b=2. Check all odd corrections on that finite list. classification.py implements the complete terminating procedure without a partner-degree cutoff.
theorems.odd_total_degree: S_D=(-1)^b D! (c)_b(d)_a; therefore c<b or d<a.
theorems.line_parameter: g=gcd(a,b), c=(b/g)n−1,d=(a/g)n−1,n>=1; nonzero S3 continuation at n=0 is −6(a−b)[a²+b²−3(a+b)+2].

theorems.title: Balanced monomials have a closed complete classification
theorems.statement: With P_2 the total-degree<=2 polynomials: E((qp)^2)=k[q]+k[p]+k[qp]; E((qp)^3)=k[qp]+P_2+span{qp^11,q^11p}; E((qp)^m)=k[qp]+P_2 for every m>=4. All sums are vector-space sums. For m<=1 every polynomial is exact.
theorems.proof_certificate: S3 and S5 factor through (d-c); a formal elimination certificate makes simultaneous off-diagonal vanishing impossible for m>=4,c+d>2. Exact symbolic coefficient replay is in verify.py.

theorems.title: Sharp criterion for infinitely many noncommuting exact directions
theorems.statement: For a nonlinear monomial H=q^a p^b with a+b>=3, E(H)/(E(H) intersect ker{H,-}) is infinite-dimensional if and only if min(a,b)<=2.
theorems.sufficiency: If a=1 or 2, p^r have distinct nonzero Poisson images and are exact by derivative width. If a=0, use qp^r. Swap coordinates when b<=2.
theorems.necessity: For unequal a,b>=3, MON-02 makes E finite-dimensional. For equal a=b>=3, MON-03 leaves only a finite-dimensional off-diagonal part; the infinite diagonal algebra commutes.

theorems.title: Ordinary powers do not generate automatic exact partners
theorems.statement: S3(a,b;ar,br)=-2ab r(a-b)(r-1)[(a+b)(r+1)-3]. Thus for unequal a,b>=2 and integer r>=2, H^r is classically commuting but not Moyal-exact. When unequal a,b>=3, E(H) intersect ker{H,-}=span{1,H}.
theorems.distinction: Star powers may depend on hbar and do not answer the hbar-independent symbol question.

table_scope: All 55 unequal Hamiltonians 2<=a<b<=12, each with every partner degree completely classified by the finite theorem. Separate bounded grids cross-check implementation only.
open: A universal closed list of exceptional finite basis exponents for all unequal a,b is not claimed; a complete effective algorithm is supplied.
The criterion does not classify nonmonomial polynomial Hamiltonians or equivalence under nonlinear canonical transformations.
No claim that E(H) is an ordinary polynomial algebra or is invariant under Hamiltonian evolution.
